basic_details.job_title: District Court Solan Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for Licenced Typist cum Computer Operator Posts

age_limit.details: A person desirous to be registered as a Licenced Typist-cum-Computer Operator shall have attained the age of 18 years. No upper age limit or specific cut-off date for age is mentioned in the notification.

qualification.details: Candidates must possess a Certificate of Bonafide Himachali.

how_to_apply: Download the prescribed application format (Annexure-A) attached with the notification.
Affix two latest passport size photographs duly attested on the application and the specified photo box.
Attach certificates of university or board regarding academic qualifications.
Attach Birth Certificate and Aadhaar Card.
Attach Latest Character Certificate issued by Tehsildar or equivalent Authority.
Ensure your mobile number and email address are stated clearly on the candidate's details.
Send or submit the completed application so that it reaches the office of the District & Sessions Judge, Solan on or before 17 October 2026 positively.
important_instructions: Applications received after 17 October 2026 shall not be entertained. Incomplete applications or those received after the above date shall be rejected. Applications must be sent in the enclosed prescribed format as Annexure-A only. Candidates must have attained the age of 18 years. Applicants must be bonafide residents of Himachal Pradesh as evidenced by the required certificate.

faq.question: Q1. What is the District Court Solan recruitment 2026 for?
faq.answer: District Court Solan has invited applications to fill 6 posts of Licenced Typist-cum-Computer Operator to work in the court complex at District Headquarters, Solan.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in District Court Solan recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 6 vacancies have been advertised for the Licenced Typist-cum-Computer Operator post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for District Court Solan recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications is 17 October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for District Court Solan Typist?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess at least Matriculation or equivalent qualification from a recognized University or Board of School Education.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for District Court Solan recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates must have attained the age of 18 years. The notification does not specify an upper age limit.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for District Court Solan recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for District Court Solan recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates must apply offline using the prescribed format (Annexure-A) along with required documents and submit it to the office of the District & Sessions Judge, Solan on or before 17 October 2026.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application for District Court Solan vacancies?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted in offline mode.

faq.question: Q9. Is a Bonafide Himachali certificate required to apply?
faq.answer: Yes, a Certificate of Bonafide Himachali is one of the mandatory documents required to be attached with the application.

faq.question: Q10. Where should the application form be sent?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the office of the District & Sessions Judge, Solan, District Solan, Himachal Pradesh.
